record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>, when Doeg<WH01673> the Edomite<WH0130> came<WH0935><WTH8800> and told<WH05046><WTH8686> Saul<WH07586>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, David<WH01732> is come<WH0935><WTH8804> to the house<WH01004> of Ahimelech<WH0288>.<Fo><Fo> Why boastest<WH01984><WTH8691> thou thyself in mischief<WH07451>, O mighty<WH01368> man? the goodness<WH02617> of God<WH0410> <FI>endureth<Fi> continually<WH03117>. <RF>Maschil: or, of instruction<Rf>
Thy tongue<WH03956> deviseth<WH02803><WTH8799> mischiefs<WH01942>; like a sharp<WH03913><WTH8794> razor<WH08593>, working<WH06213><WTH8802> deceitfully<WH07423>.
Thou lovest<WH0157><WTH8804> evil<WH07451> more than good<WH02896>; <FI>and<Fi> lying<WH08267> rather than to speak<WH01696><WTH8763> righteousness<WH06664>. Selah<WH05542>.
Thou lovest<WH0157><WTH8804> all devouring<WH01105> words<WH01697>, O <FI>thou<Fi> deceitful<WH04820> tongue<WH03956>. <RF>O thou...: or, and the deceitful tongue<Rf>

God<WH0410> shall likewise destroy<WH05422><WTH8799> thee for ever<WH05331>, he shall take thee away<WH02846><WTH8799>, and pluck thee out<WH05255><WTH8799> of <FI>thy<Fi> dwelling place<WH0168>, and root thee out<WH08327><WTH8765> of the land<WH0776> of the living<WH02416>. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>destroy...: Heb. beat thee down<Rf><CM>
The righteous<WH06662> also shall see<WH07200><WTH8799>, and fear<WH03372><WTH8799>, and shall laugh<WH07832><WTH8799> at him:

Lo, <FI>this is<Fi> the man<WH01397> <FI>that<Fi> made<WH07760><WTH8799> not God<WH0430> his strength<WH04581>; but trusted<WH0982><WTH8799> in the abundance<WH07230> of his riches<WH06239>, <FI>and<Fi>  strengthened<WH05810><WTH8799> himself in his wickedness<WH01942>. <RF>wickedness: or, substance<Rf>
But I <FI>am<Fi> like a green<WH07488> olive tree<WH02132> in the house<WH01004> of God<WH0430>: I trust<WH0982><WTH8804> in the mercy<WH02617> of God<WH0430> for ever<WH05769> and ever<WH05703>.

I will praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee for ever<WH05769>, because thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> : and I will wait<WH06960><WTH8762> on thy name<WH08034>; for <FI>it is<Fi> good<WH02896> before thy saints<WH02623>.<CM>
